notes.title: The Trick or Threat Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

To celebrate Halloween and Steam Scream Fest, we are releasing a bunch of new character skins for you to play in MACE: Mapinguari's Temple!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514242/a8fadf50db2eda1299b210b2aaf2c3e21e1f6f58.png

In order, they are the Living Ghost, Pumpkin Head, Baroness Von Fangs, Sir Frankendude, Saci, Ligma Bone Boy and Wichy Michy! If you are in our discord, you will notice some references!

But wait! There's more!

We present you an extra character skin for the game: the Hipster Hacker! You might have noticed him in the Scout image during the voting for the new role. Although the Scout role didn't made it (for now), the Hipster Hacker is here for you to play with!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514242/51b29ab41e0f428b7329fd321f670bdf9b37d2a6.png

Also, regarding the new role, we are still working on implementing the Psion role in the game and, as soon as we have any news regarding it, we will be sure to share it here and on our Discord (if you are not there yet, please do join us here!).

Thank you for playing MACE: Mapinguari's Temple!

notes.title: Small Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

First of all, we would like to thank everyone for the feedback sent so far! In this patch, we have done the following fixes and changes:

Gameplay changes:

 The key now has a smaller weight, so you walk faster while carrying it.
 Made the distance for in-game voice volume decay greater, so you can better hear other players.


UX changes

 Now you can press ESC to both open and close the in-game menu.


Bugfixes:

 Removed some unused commands from the control settings screen.
 Fixed an issue with the "Microphone Always On".


That would be all for now, but there's more coming, so keep a close eye! And remember, if you have any feedback, bug report, suggestion or just want someone to play with, stop by our discord! Here's the link:

https://discord.gg/KwhgUX8BUh

Thank you!
- Eduardo

notes.title: Announcing the release date!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Eduardo from Tavern Tale here! Hope you are all doing fine and that you were able to enjoy our demo that was online up to April 4th. Now, we have good news to share (both if you didn't played the demo or if you are eager to enjoy the game again)! Ready?

We are very happy to announce that MACE: Mapinguari's Temple will be released at April 29th! We have been polishing the game and adding new content based on Steam Next Fest feedback. We are eager to see you guys playing it as soon as it releases! Be ready to hunt some idols, run from the Mapinguari and discover who is the Cultist!

If you want to know more about the game or about Tavern Tale, be sure to join our discord or follow us on our social media!
You can access all of them through our Linktree:

https://linktr.ee/taverntalestudio

Have a great weekend everyone!
- Eduardo
